name: Able SEO by VibeSEO
description:
VibeSEO brings SEO research and blog content workflows into Claude. Run keyword research, competitor and domain analysis, backlink checks, technical site audits, and Google Search Console reporting — then turn what you find into blog drafts, all scoped to the projects in your VibeSEO account.

Keyword research
• Search volume, keyword difficulty, CPC, and search intent for any keyword
• Related, question, preposition, and comparison keyword ideas, plus Google autocomplete

Competitor & domain analysis
• Domain authority, organic traffic estimates, and rank distribution
• A domain's top organic keywords and top pages
• Head-to-head competitive overviews and keyword-gap opportunities

Backlinks
• Backlink profile: total backlinks, referring domains, domain rank, and spam score
• Individual backlink lists with anchor text and link strength, plus backlink history over time

Google Search Console
• Clicks, impressions, CTR, and average position for your verified sites
• Top queries and landing pages, daily trends, and per-query detail

Technical site audits
• Crawl your site and get a prioritized list of SEO issues, audit scores, and crawled-page summaries

Content workflow
• Generate blog topic ideas, draft SEO articles, and approve and schedule them for publishing

VibeSEO reads and writes only the projects in your connected account. Connect your VibeSEO account to get started.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Able SEO by VibeSEO to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Able SEO by VibeSEO to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.vibeseo.dev/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Able SEO by VibeSEO MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Able SEO by VibeSEO lists 53 MCP tools, including approve_post, autocomplete_keywords, backlink_history, comparison_keywords, competitive_overview, domain_competitor_suggestions, domain_overview, domain_top_keywords, domain_top_pages, domain_traffic_history, generate_post, and get_audit.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Able SEO by VibeSEO?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Able SEO by VibeSEO in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.

_published_faq.name: Does Able SEO by VibeSEO MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Able SEO by VibeSEO requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.

_published_faq.name: Who develops Able SEO by VibeSEO?

acceptedAnswer.text: Able SEO by VibeSEO is developed by VibeSEO. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
